svg.title: Approved time employee payroll and period remittances
svg.desc: Approved time employee payroll and period remittances. Solid labeled arrows identify stored keys and explicit ledger sources. Dashed arrows show punch support or summary aggregation. Register recognition, employee payment, and remittance each reach the ledger separately. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
